grades: Middle and high school (high school camps run separately)
name: Lane Community College Summer Early College Camps
what_you_do: Free 4 day career camps on the Lane campus. You can try car repair basics, CompuCon computer science, Junior Chefs Academy or media arts.
who_can_apply: Oregon middle and high school students ages 12 to 18. A parent or guardian fills out the interest form. Spots go by lottery and a student can attend only one camp per summer.
pay_detail: Free. Transportation and food are on your own; parking is free and LTD buses come to campus.
duration: Monday to Thursday, about 4 days (2026 high school dates: Aug 10 to 13 and Aug 24 to 27)
deadline_text: 2026 registration is closed and most camps were full. Page says registration info is updated before each summer; check in spring.
how_to_apply: A parent or guardian sends in the High School Registration Form for the camps the student wants. A lottery picks who gets in. The parent hears back.
notes: Lane also runs free summer academies for students of color in Lane County. They are called Rites of Passage. There are 4 of them. They are African American, Asian and Pacific Islander, Bridge of the Gods and Puertas Abiertas. See the Lane Community Education pages.
